Planning Document: docs/dcps/INNERWEST/Marrickville/Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 19 Marrickville Road, Central.pdf

Clause 9.19.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): To protect and preserve the identified period buildings within the precinct and encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.19.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): To protect the identified Heritage Items  within the precinct.

Clause 9.19.2 - height_limit (development_control): To maintain distinctly single storey streetscapes that exist within the precinct.

Clause 9.19.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): To protect groups or runs of buildings which retain their original built form including roof forms, original detailing and finishes.

Clause 9.19.2 - other (land_use_zoning): To preserve the predominantly low to medium density resident ial character of the precinct.

Clause 9.19.2 - parking (development_control): To ensure that the provision and location of off -street car parking does not adversely impact the amenity of the precinct.

Clause 9.19.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): To protect the identified values of the Inter -War Group Heritage Conservation Area.

Clause 9.19.3 - heritage (heritage_protection): Refer to Part 8 (Heritage) of this DCP for detailed c ontrols and guidelines.
